title: Senior RF Antenna Designer
desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X).
Senior Product Applications Engineer
About The Role
We are seeking an
Application Engineer focused on Antenna Design
to support customers and internal teams with the design, simulation, validation, and integration of antennas in advanced RF systems. This role bridges
theory, practical antenna implementation, and customer engagement
, helping translate system requirements into optimized antenna solutions for communications, radar, aerospace, defense, and emerging wireless applications.
The ideal candidate combines
strong antenna fundamentals
,
hands‑on measurement experience
, and the ability to
communicate complex RF concepts clearly
to customers and cross‑functional teams.
Key Responsibilities
Antenna Design & Technical Support
Design, simulate, and optimize antennas (PCB, embedded, patch, dipole, array, phased array) for a wide range of frequencies and applications.
Support customers with antenna selection, placement, matching, tuning, and integration into RF systems.
Provide expert guidance on antenna performance trade‑offs including bandwidth, efficiency, gain, polarization, isolation, and radiation patterns.
Assist customers in diagnosing and resolving antenna‑related system issues such as mismatch, coupling, detuning, and EMC/EMI interactions.
Simulation, Measurement & Validation
Use EM and RF simulation tools to model antenna structures and environments.
Perform antenna measurements including S‑parameters, radiation patterns, efficiency, and gain using VNAs, anechoic chambers, and OTA setups.
Correlate simulation results with measured data and recommend design improvements.
Support system‑level validation including link budgets, MIMO performance, and phased‑array calibration.
Customer Engagement & Applications Support
Serve as a technical point of contact for customers, answering application questions and providing design recommendations.
Support customer evaluations, prototypes, and design‑ins.
Deliver technical presentations, application notes, and reference designs focused on antenna integration and best practices.
Collaborate with sales and field teams to support key customer engagements and design wins.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
Work closely with IC designers, system architects, and product line teams to ensure antenna considerations are addressed early in product development.
Provide feedback to product development teams based on customer needs and field experience.
Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and training related to antenna and RF system design.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Electromagnetics, or a related field.
Strong fundamentals in antenna theory, electromagnetics, and RF/microwave design.
Hands‑on experience with antenna measurements and RF test equipment (VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generator).
Familiarity with antenna matching networks and RF front‑end integration.
Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both expert and non‑expert audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree or PhD with a focus on antennas or electromagnetics.
Experience with phased arrays, beamforming, MIMO, or mmWave antennas.
Proficiency with EM/RF simulation tools such as HFSS, CST, FEKO, ADS, or similar.
Experience supporting customer-facing applications or field engineering roles.
Familiarity with wireless standards or applications (5G/6G, radar, satellite, aerospace & defense, IoT).
Soft Skills & Attributes
Strong problem‑solving mindset with attention to detail.
Customer‑focused, collaborative, and proactive.
Comfortable working across disciplines and time zones.
Ability to balance deep technical work with customer interaction.
Why Join Us
Work on cutting‑edge RF and antenna technologies used in real‑world systems.
Collaborate with experts across RF ICs, systems, and applications.
Influence product direction through direct customer feedback.
Grow technical depth while expanding customer‑facing impact.
Why You'll Love Working Here
At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world.
You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and mentorship from industry experts. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect.
